item.create_shared.hard_hat.tooltip.summ: Heavy-duty protective headgear designed for _factory safety_ and _hazard prevention_.
item.create_shared.hard_hat.tooltip.beha: _Deflects 100%%_ of damage from falling _anvils_, _stalactites_, and _blocks_ with a metallic clang.
_Reduces 75%%_ of damage from _kinetic crushing_, _suffocation_, and _high-speed wall collisions_.
create_shared.ponder.factory_vent_gate.t: Factory Exhaust Vents act as operable gates for duct systems
Right-click the front to manually open or close the vent gate
Redstone power can also automate opening and closing the gate
Walking towards an open wall vent smoothly drops players into crawl pose to enter inside!
create_shared.ponder.factory_vent_duct_n: Factory Vent Ducts seamlessly connect on all 6 sides to build crawl tunnels
Vertical ducts act as internal ladders, allowing players to climb straight up and down
Placing ducts side-by-side automatically removes internal corner beams and edges
This creates wide, open crawlways and hollow rooms without internal obstructions
create_shared.ponder.factory_vent_airflo: Encased Fans facing directly into ducts supply airflow to the ventilation network
The system totals all connected fan speeds into a shared Total Airflow (32 + 64 = 96 RPM)
Engineer's Goggles display the network's airflow, connected fans, and open exhausts on any vent or duct
Air blowing out of vents acts just like an Encased Fan, pushing entities and processing items
Reversing fan rotation creates vacuum suction, pulling entities towards the vent
Airflow distributes across open vents. Closing one vent concentrates power into the others!
Large duct systems experience friction loss; add enough fan power to prevent dissipation
create_shared.ponder.tag.ventilation.des: Hollow exhaust vents and multi-directional ductwork for crawl tunnels and air circulation
create_shared.config.distributionMode.to: How airflow is distributed among open exhaust vents (DISTANCE_ATTENUATED or EQUAL).
Decay ratio per duct distance in DISTANCE_ATTENUATED mode (higher = faster dropoff with distance).
create_shared.config.frictionLossPerDuct: Airflow (RPM) lost per duct in the network due to internal friction.
create_shared.config.minAirflowPerVent.t: Minimum airflow (RPM) required at an open vent to produce wind or suction.
create_shared.config.maxWindRange.toolti: Maximum range in blocks that wind/suction can reach from an open vent.
create_shared.config.windStrength.toolti: Multiplier for physical push/pull force applied to entities by vents.
create_shared.config.maxNetworkBlocks.to: Maximum number of connected ducts/vents scanned in a single ventilation network.
